newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares soft after long weekend, Telecom firms.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares soft after long weekend, Telecom firms.

text.p: * NZ shares ease, but shrug off U.S. fall
* Brokers report quiet start after Monday holiday
* Telecom firms against the trend, back up to $7.00
LAST CHG * NZSE40 cap index -6.04 at 2,350.76
370 -10 * Volume NZ$13.4 million. Futures steady at 1186
ANZ Banking Group rose 20 cents to NZ$9.85 after a strong rise in Australia yesterday. Colonial Group shed seven cents to $3.56 against a $3.57 equivalent at the close in Australia on Monday.
Market leader Telecom firmed against the trend, adding three cents to $7.00 in early trade before easing back to $6.98 after 45 minutes.
Infrastructure investor Infratil traded down three cents on small volume after going ex the issue of one right to Infratil International for every two shares.
